tool.name: check_process
tool.description: Check if a process is running and get its resource usage (CPU, memory).

when_to_use.trigger: User asks if a specific process is running
User wants to check resource usage of a process
User asks how many instances of a program are running
Troubleshooting high CPU or memory usage

parameters.param: Name of the process to find (e.g., 'python', 'ollama', 'node', 'java'). Matches any process containing this string in its command line.

safety_rules.rule: This is a read-only tool - always safe to execute

example.input: How many node processes are there?
